entries.headline: Four coded broadcasts and six transports reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported four coded U.S. Air Force radio broadcasts heard that day and six military transport aircraft airborne, including one near Korea and Japan.

entries.headline: AFRICOM strike report relayed
entries.summary: War Watch Intel relayed an AFRICOM report, credited to @reagan0965, about U.S. strikes targeting al-Shabaab. The visible post did not give the strikes’ location or date.

entries.headline: Coded broadcasts and reconnaissance aircraft reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported four coded U.S. Air Force radio broadcasts heard that day and multiple transport and surveillance aircraft airborne over the United States, including two reconnaissance aircraft.

entries.headline: Transport aircraft and a coded broadcast reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported four U.S. Air Force transport aircraft and two specialised military jets airborne over the United States, with one coded radio broadcast heard in the preceding hour.

entries.headline: Transports, radio traffic and regional air activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported multiple large transport aircraft airborne over the United States, a rise in coded military radio broadcasts near Iran, and air activity near Korea and Japan at nearly 4.5 times its usual level. It did not identify a connection between these observations.

entries.headline: Iraq mission report relayed
entries.summary: War Watch Intel relayed a Stars and Stripes report, credited to @reagan0965, saying the United States had ended its military mission in Iraq. This was attributed third-party reporting, not an observation made by the account.

entries.headline: USAF transports and elevated regional air activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported six U.S. Air Force transport aircraft airborne over the continental United States, with air activity near Korea and Japan at nearly five times its usual level and in the Baltic region at more than three times usual.

entries.headline: UK airbase incident report relayed
entries.summary: War Watch Intel relayed an Insider Paper report, credited to @reagan0965, that the UK prime minister had described “strong indications” of Iranian involvement in an airbase incident. This was attributed third-party reporting.

entries.headline: C-40B callsign SAM951 sighting relayed
entries.summary: War Watch Intel relayed a sighting credited to @reagan0965 of a U.S. Air Force C-40B, callsign SAM951, hex AE11F6 and registration 01-0041. The post identified the 89th Airlift Wing at Andrews Air Force Base but did not state the aircraft’s current location or mission.

entries.headline: Five USAF transports and Customs aircraft reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported five U.S. Air Force heavy transport aircraft airborne over the United States alongside a U.S. Customs surveillance aircraft. It characterised the activity as unusually high for the hour but did not identify any mission.

entries.headline: USAF surveillance plane and six transports reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported a U.S. Air Force surveillance aircraft and six military transport aircraft airborne over the United States. It said no coded broadcasts had been detected during that hour.

entries.headline: USAF surveillance and command aircraft reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported a U.S. Air Force surveillance aircraft and a nuclear command jet airborne over the United States alongside multiple cargo transports. It said no coded radio broadcasts had been detected during that hour.

skyglass.caption: Military aircraft movement reports.

entries.headline: Autonomous Warfare Command report shared
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a DefenseScoop report about a new U.S. Autonomous Warfare Command intended to integrate military drone operations. This was a linked news report.

entries.headline: Belgian F-16 delivery report shared
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a report from The Aviationist saying Belgium was preparing to deliver its first three F-16AM/BM jets to Ukraine after delays. The post described preparations, rather than a completed delivery.

entries.headline: P-8 departure alert at Orange Park
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an alert showing a P-8 off the ground at Orange Park, Florida, United States. Its destination and mission were not confirmed.

entries.headline: ASY173 P-8 on-ground alert at Marton
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an alert listing a P-8, callsign ASY173, on the ground at Marton, New Zealand. Its mission and reason for being there were not confirmed.

entries.headline: E-6 departure alert at Moore
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an alert showing an E-6 off the ground at Moore, Oklahoma, United States. The alert did not establish its destination or mission.

entries.headline: B-1 on-ground alert at Highworth
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an alert listing a B-1 on the ground at Highworth, Great Britain. The post did not independently establish the precise site or reason for its presence.

entries.headline: P-8 departure alert at Varsoli
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an alert showing a P-8 off the ground at Varsoli, India. Its destination and mission were not confirmed.

entries.headline: E-2 on-ground alert at Shiloh
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an alert listing an E-2, callsign STLJW21, on the ground at Shiloh, Illinois, United States. Its mission and reason for being there were not confirmed.

entries.headline: P-8 reported on the ground at Orange Park
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an alert showing a P-8 on the ground at Orange Park, Florida, United States. Its mission and reason for being there were not confirmed.

entries.headline: P-8 reported off the ground at Fruit Cove
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an alert showing a P-8 off the ground at Fruit Cove, Florida, United States. The alert did not confirm its destination or mission.

entries.headline: P-8 reported off the ground at Orange Park
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an alert showing a P-8 off the ground at Orange Park, Florida, United States. The alert did not confirm its destination or mission.

entries.headline: Another P-8 departure alert at Orange Park
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted a separate P-8 off-ground alert at Orange Park, Florida, United States. The post did not establish whether it concerned the same aircraft as its later Orange Park alert.
